searchText: Has "ACD call" been renamed "Execution Layer Meeting" in the future? <dannyryan> ACDe ACDc ? 😅 Yes, we made two changes, actually! First, we've decided to harmonize EL and CL call naming because it was a bit of a misnomer that the EL call was called "AllCoreDevs" but we had half the client teams on the CL side. So, we now have ACDE/ACDC (and CL folks get the coolest name ⚡ !) Also, we're moving the calls from the @EthereumFoundation Youtube channel to @EthereumProtocol, which was the OG Ethereum YT channel. I'll update the README in ethereum/pm to reflect all this sometime this week 🙂 Is it really ECD and CDC though? Awesome! Good name : ) ACDC sounds so much better 🙂 what about EDC (like the music festival) and ACDC /joke

excerpts.content: Has "ACD call" been renamed "Execution Layer Meeting" in the future?

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content:
Yes, we made two changes, actually! First, we've decided to harmonize EL and CL call naming because it was a bit of a misnomer that the EL call was called "AllCoreDevs" but we had half the client teams on the CL side. So, we now have ACDE/ACDC (and CL folks get the coolest name ⚡ !) 

Also, we're moving the calls from the @EthereumFoundation Youtube channel to @EthereumProtocol, which was the OG Ethereum YT channel. 

I'll update the README in ethereum/pm to reflect all this sometime this week 🙂
